# Incident report (draft, generated by an AI agent)

*Generated 2026-11-07 22:50 UTC by `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` in 3 tool steps, cost $0.0032. A human must review it before it is shared.*

**Alert:** Checkout Overview alert: elevated errors and/or latency on service `checkout` (thresholds: 5xx ratio > 5% or p95 latency > 2s for 5 minutes). Find out why.

## Summary

Checkout Overview alert confirmed: /checkout 5xx ratio ~45% and p95 latency ~7.6s, versus a 5% and 2s threshold. The primary cause is a PayPal provider timeout outage; Stripe is healthy. The DB pool and the recent deploy were ruled out. Severity is SEV2 per the handbook for provider timeouts, to be escalated to SEV1 if payment failures exceed 20%, which has not been verified.

## Impact

/checkout is failing and slow for all traffic routed to PayPal. Overall /checkout 5xx ratio is ~45% and p95 is ~7.6s. /orders/{order_id} and /products are unaffected (~0.09s p95, 0 errors). Stripe-routed traffic shows p95 ~0.37-0.45s and near-zero errors. Exact payment failure percentage was not measured directly.

## Hypotheses, most likely first

### 1. PayPal provider timeout outage causing /checkout 5xx and latency (confidence 93%)

- PayPal p95 latency rose from ~0.44s to ~7.85s while Stripe stayed at ~0.37-0.45s
- payment_provider_errors_total{provider=paypal} peaked at ~1.18/s and was ~0.87/s at last sample; Stripe errors ~0
- Loki: 106 lines of 'payment provider timeout' with status=504, error=ProviderTimeout, provider=paypal, all on /checkout, in one distinct pattern

### 2. Regression from deploy v2026.11.07-1 (gift-message field) (confidence 4%)

- Deploy occurred at 17:46:28Z, about 5 hours before onset at ~22:39Z
- Errors are provider timeouts (504 ProviderTimeout), not application exceptions; no error pattern points to the gift-message code
- Only the PayPal path is affected and /products and /orders on the same build are healthy

### 3. Checkout DB connection pool exhaustion (confidence 3%)

- db_pool_connections_in_use / db_pool_size peaked at only ~0.1 over the window and was 0 at last sample
- No db_pool_wait_seconds pressure reported; /orders and /products (which use the DB) are unaffected

### 4. Stripe provider degradation (confidence 2%)

- Stripe p95 ~0.37-0.45s throughout the window
- Stripe errors ~0 (peak 0.036/s, last 0)

## Proposed next actions (a human decides and executes these)

1. Verify the payment failure percentage directly from payment metrics to decide whether to escalate from SEV2 to SEV1 (threshold 20%).
2. Per runbooks/payment-provider-timeout.md (owner: Payments Platform), consider failing over payments to Stripe by setting the payments.primary_provider feature flag to stripe, and confirm the flag change with the on-call owner.
3. Do not blindly retry failed charges; rely on idempotency keys to avoid double charges during or after failover.
4. Notify the Payments Platform team and check PayPal's status page to determine whether this is a provider-side incident.
5. After PayPal recovers, restore payments.primary_provider to its prior value and confirm /checkout 5xx ratio and p95 return to baseline (~0.47s).
6. Read the full runbook (only the title and summary were reviewed) before executing any step.
7. Post-incident: review timeout and circuit-breaker settings for the PayPal client so a provider slowdown fails fast instead of holding requests for ~7.8s.
